title: SimEarth
shortDescription: SimEarth is organized in GameAtlas's Super Nintendo Entertainment System simulation collection with a source-linked record and deterministic catalog context.
highlights: Places a source-linked simulation entry in the Super Nintendo Entertainment System browsing path.
Keeps third-party commentary and scores out of the linked metadata path.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Indexed for the Super Nintendo Entertainment System simulation discovery path using a direct Wikidata structured-data record; this remains source-aware discovery without copied review text.
